title: Refuse unsafe profile creation and application
description: Centralize structured refusal for profile creation and calibrated generation when physical evidence is insufficient, assumptions are incompatible, or loading and print-configuration confirmations are missing.
acceptanceCriteria: Current unresolved physical prerequisites always prevent profile creation and calibrated generation
Insufficient evidence, incompatible exact assumptions, stale fingerprints, missing loading confirmation, and missing configuration confirmation have distinct stable reasons
Refusal preserves draft, profile, preparation, and artifact state and identifies corrective action
UI exposes reasons and restores focus without implying that software confirmation proves physical suitability

steps.details: Add stable reason codes, affected assumptions, evidence-safe messages, and corrective actions for every PRD 26 refusal class.
Evaluate physical gate, policy qualification, exact compatibility, loading confirmation, and configuration confirmation before any write or render effect.
Disable or refuse actions with semantic text, linked details, announced status, and focus restoration.
Cover each reason independently plus combined failures and assert no profile, preparation, or calibrated artifact is created.

technicalNotes: Maximum execution scope is ten minutes; centralize reasons and run focused no-effect tests only.
BLOCKED: only refusal behavior is currently implementable; successful physical paths cannot be claimed.
Operator confirmation records assumptions and does not verify printer behavior.
